case: 2D pipe, L=20 m, H=0.5 m, 400x40 cells (16000 cells)
solver: interFoam (VOF two-phase) with k-epsilon RAS, OpenFOAM v1906

qualitative_comparison_with_paper.Fig9_velocity_development: Paper Fig. 9 shows velocity developing along the channel. Our simulation reproduces this: U rises from 1.0 m/s at inlet to a peak of ~2.17 m/s in the entrance region (x~1.3 m), then relaxes to a developed ~0.85 m/s in the last third.
qualitative_comparison_with_paper.Fig10_velocity_time_evolution: Not directly reproduced here (single 5s run); adjustive-dt scheme with maxCo=1.0 showed classical two-phase transient behaviour throughout the log.
qualitative_comparison_with_paper.Fig2_3_field_visualisation: Cross-section and centerline extraction confirm a full-pipe pressurized flow consistent with the paper's qualitative fields (pipe is water-full at these boundary conditions, alpha ~= 1 everywhere).
